# GraphScene draws node labels and flies its camera to a node

## Context

The Institution's Observatory renders through `Neo.canvas.GraphScene` (`AgentOS.canvas.Observatory` extends it). At the operator's display, the installed sitting (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#485) could not name a single well, because nothing on the canvas carries a name (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#839).

The design seat's read of the Observatory's zoom ladder (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#312, comment 6222093228) puts the mechanics, "a label/overlay hook, fly-to", in this class, and the names and values in the Observatory. It orders "the label layer and fly-to" as the first leaf after row 3's walk. That walk has run, and it failed on exactly this.

## The Problem

`GraphScene` draws points, lines and beaded paths with one program, and nothing draws text. A consumer that wants names on the canvas has two ways out today, and both are wrong:
- DOM labels positioned from the App Worker trail every orbit frame by a cross-worker round trip.
- A subclass can add its own text pass, but only by reaching into `program`, `surfaces` and `render`.

The camera moves only under the pointer (`updateMouseState`, `onWheel`) and through `fit()`, so a list row cannot turn it to a node.

The extraction (`#19261`) kept labels off the GL surface: "they stay in the pane's DOM head". The installed sitting is the evidence that changes this. The head carries counts and the hovered node, but never a well's name.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Drawing.** `src/canvas/GraphScene.mjs` has one program (`SHADERS`, `compile`). `upload()` builds `surfaces` once per scene. `render()` draws edges, then path lines, beads and nodes, or the LOD centroids at the far level. A frame is owed only to a change (`requestFrame`). `initGl` sets the premultiplied blend `ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA`.
- **Contracts.** `normalizeScene` validates the scene's arrays and names what doesn't fit. `getStats` reports the camera, counts, LOD and uploads.
- **Camera.** The `camera` member holds `{dist, pitch, target, touched, yaw}`. `fit()` frames an untouched camera, and `zoom` bounds the wheel relative to the fitted distance. The static `project()` maps a point to the surface, or to `null` behind the camera.
- **Context loss** drops `program` and `surfaces`; a restore re-runs `initGl` and then `upload`.
- **Text in the canvas worker** has a precedent: `src/canvas/Sparkline.mjs` draws with a 2D context's `fillText`.
- **Specs.** `test/playwright/unit/canvas/GraphScene.spec.mjs` covers the static math without GL. `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/GraphScene.spec.mjs` covers `examples/component/graphScene`.

## The Fix

1. **Labels.** `normalizeScene` takes an optional `labels`: `{nodes, texts, sizes?, color, outline}`.
   - `nodes` are node indices in priority order, with one text each. `sizes` are font sizes in CSS px, defaulting to `labelStyle.size`. The two colours arrive with the scene, like every other colour.
   - `upload()` rasterizes each text once into an atlas texture, drawn on a worker `OffscreenCanvas` 2D context at the drawing buffer's pixel ratio, with the fill over an outline stroke. A ratio change in `updateSize` re-rasterizes.
   - `render()` draws the labels last, at every level of detail, with a second small program. Each frame it projects the labelled nodes and places their labels in priority order. It skips a label that is behind the camera, off the surface, or overlapping one already placed, stops at `labelStyle.max`, and draws the placed labels as screen-aligned quads in the premultiplied blend.
   - Placement is a static function, so it is tested without GL.
2. **Fly-to.** A remote `flyTo({index, distance, duration})`.
   - The camera's target eases to the node, and its distance to `distance` × the fitted distance, clamped to `zoom`, over `duration` ms. Each step owes one frame.
   - When the pointer takes the camera, the flight ends. No node moves.
   - Defaults live in a `flight` config.
3. **Stats.** `getStats().labels` returns `{count, drawn: [{index, text, x, y}]}`: the labels the last frame drew, in CSS px. A spec or the Neural Link then reads what is drawn, not what was asked for. A scene without labels returns `null`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `setScene({labels})` | this ticket | names nodes to label, drawn above the scene | absent: today's frame | `normalizeScene` JSDoc | unit + e2e |
| `flyTo({index, distance, duration})` remote | this ticket | eases the camera to a node | an index the scene lacks: no change | method JSDoc | unit (static step) + e2e |
| `getStats().labels` | this ticket | the last frame's drawn labels | `null` without labels | `getStats` JSDoc | e2e |
| `labelStyle`, `flight` configs | this ticket | font, size, gap, max on screen; flight defaults | n/a | config JSDoc | unit |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A scene with `labels` draws each placed label at its node, in its colour over its outline, crisp at the buffer's pixel ratio. A scene without `labels` draws today's frame.
- [ ] The placement function keeps priority order. It skips a label behind the camera, off the surface or overlapping a placed one, and stops at `labelStyle.max`. Its unit arms go red on `dev` first.
- [ ] `normalizeScene` rejects a label index that names no node, and a `texts`/`nodes` length mismatch, naming the counts in the existing error style.
- [ ] `flyTo` ends with the camera's target at the node and its distance at the clamped ratio. A drag or a wheel during a flight ends it, and an index the scene lacks changes nothing.
- [ ] `getStats().labels.drawn` lists what the last frame drew. The e2e on `examples/component/graphScene` reads it before and after an orbit.
- [ ] After a lost and restored context, the labels draw again.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Consumer receipt: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#839 draws its wells' names and flies to a well through this API, verified by that PR's arms.

## Out of Scope

- The rest of the design read's zoom ladder. The wider zoom range and near threshold, the hover halo, fovea labels by distance to the orbit target, zoom to the pointer, keys and the crossfaded morph are its later leaves, and their values are the Observatory's.
- Picking or hovering a label, per-label colours, text along paths, and SDF fonts. A bitmap atlas at the buffer's ratio is enough for screen-aligned labels.
- Web fonts in the canvas worker. Labels use the worker's system font stack (`labelStyle.font`).

## Avoided Traps

- **DOM labels from the App Worker** cost a round trip per orbit frame, so the names trail the points.
- **A second transferred 2D canvas** (the read's "2D overlay layer") adds another surface through `SharedCanvas` and another worker handoff, just for text. Quads from an atlas give the same overlay in the same frame, and each text is rasterized once per scene, not once per frame.
- **A text pass in the consumer's subclass** couples app code to `program` and `surfaces`.
